classification.difficultyReason: Discover a manageable decimal pattern for the enormous subtraction, separate the trailing 7992 from the leading nines, and determine their exact count before summing the digits.

content.prompt: Find the sum of the digits of $10^{2008}-2008$.

answer.short:
$18\,063$

The number has 2004 leading nines followed by 7992.
answer.worked:
$10^{2008}-10^4$ has 2004 nines followed by four zeros, and $10^4-2008=7992$. Therefore,

$$\begin{align*}10^{2008}-2008&=(10^{2008}-10^4)+(10^4-2008)\\10^{2008}-2008&=\underbrace{99\cdots99}_{2004\text{ nines}}7992\end{align*}$$

Let $S$ be the sum of the digits.

$$\begin{align*}S&=2004\times9+7+9+9+2\\S&=18\,063\end{align*}$$
